about: Proof reels (proof.py, the one-command path): the story reel builder's four looks (valmera-stories/reel.py), each carrying a real Valmera before and after with its own sound. A style rests for three films.

styles.name: Proof Reel
styles.look: Real footage of what each line names fills the phone, a new picture about every half second, moving; heavy grotesk display words in yellow; the raw clip shown as uploaded, the export full frame on its own sound.
styles.hook: Frame zero is a built before-and-after: the clip as uploaded beside Valmera's export at the instant the export's picture lands, on the speaker's own voice; then the narrator's first line names what was just seen, the words and the picture agreeing.

styles.name: Proof Window
styles.look: Most pictures fill the frame; a few framed windows establish a comparison, cut fast; cyan accent, condensed capitals; the export breaks out of the window full frame.
styles.hook: Frame zero is a built before-and-after: the clip as uploaded beside Valmera's export at the instant the export's picture lands, on the speaker's own voice; then the narrator's first line names what was just seen, the words and the picture agreeing.

styles.name: Proof Pinboard
styles.look: Lines that list the editor's chores land as prints stacked on a dark board; orange accent, high-contrast serif; then the export, whole, full frame.
styles.hook: Frame zero is a built before-and-after: the clip as uploaded beside Valmera's export at the instant the export's picture lands, on the speaker's own voice; then the narrator's first line names what was just seen, the words and the picture agreeing.

styles.name: Proof Archive
styles.look: Cream serif italic display words, grain and a projector flash into each run of pictures; the export plays clean and whole.
styles.hook: Frame zero is a built before-and-after: the clip as uploaded beside Valmera's export at the instant the export's picture lands, on the speaker's own voice; then the narrator's first line names what was just seen, the words and the picture agreeing.
